name: Falsehood
summary:
A message is sent.

It's read the wrong way. And the world starts to fall apart.

This is a story about the distance between what's said and what's meant. About broken signals, stubborn hearts, and the silence that follows a word too late.

You'll wander through rain-soaked towns and echoing halls, chasing meaning in places it's long been lost. Some will listen. Some will twist your voice. And some will never hear you at all.

In the end, maybe there's no linear way to say it... only the courage to try again.
